description: The policy service's refusal strings a hybrid routing v2 caller (VSR) maps. selection_refused (HTTP 422) carries detail.reason, one of `reasons` (arc_policy_contract.SelectionRefusal, exactly). `v2_public` maps the reasons v2 added onto their public Decisions error code and status (arc_public_contract.ERRORS); every other reason keeps its pre-v2 handling. A malformed v2 decide-request member is invalid_request (HTTP 400) with detail.field, one of `invalid_request_fields`. `contract_side` codes are decided by the v2 envelope binding (arc_execution_v2.bind_v2) before any decide call, and the service never emits them.
